info.terms.title: Terms
info.privacy.title: Privacy
info.help.title: Help & feedback
info.tips.title: Safe handover tips
info.terms.0.title: A little campus teamwork
info.terms.0.body: Zarqa is a student-made lost-and-found pilot for the GUtech community. It is not a university service or an official GUtech channel. Use your own university email and post only items you really lost or found.
info.terms.1.title: Keep it honest
info.terms.1.body: Do not claim someone else's property, impersonate people, harass others, or upload unlawful content. Only share photos and information you have permission to use. Administrators may close reports or ban accounts for misuse.
info.terms.2.title: A match is a suggestion
info.terms.2.body: AI can miss items or suggest the wrong one. Check identifying details before handing anything over. Zarqa does not hold items, verify ownership, guarantee a return or arrange the handover for you. Meet safely and never pay to unlock a match.
info.terms.3.title: Your choice
info.terms.3.body: Read the Privacy page before posting. You can close reports and delete your account in Profile. The pilot may change or be unavailable. For questions, concerns or a report of misuse, email us below.
info.privacy.0.title: Who runs this?
info.privacy.0.body: Zarqa is a student pilot, not a university service. Contact the student operator at hello@tryzarqa.com for privacy questions, corrections or deletion requests. This notice describes the pilot; it does not claim legal compliance.
info.privacy.1.title: What we store
info.privacy.1.body: We store your university email, first name, profile settings and optional avatar; lost and found reports, uploaded photos, match results and review logs; and chats, handover details and read markers. Uploaded photos are re-encoded with EXIF metadata stripped. Sign-in uses a session cookie and temporary login-code records. If you enable push alerts, we store the browser's push subscription.
info.privacy.2.title: Who can see it?
info.privacy.2.body: There is no public report browser. Possible matches are shown to the lost-item owner, and confirmed matches open a private chat between owner and finder. Non-card photos can be shown with a match. Photos on reports identified as cards or IDs are visible only to their uploader, including after a claim. Administrators can review reports, owner emails, non-card photos and matching logs for moderation; the operator has server access for maintenance.
info.privacy.3.title: AI and service providers
info.privacy.3.body: For matching, report text and non-card photos may be processed by OpenAI, OpenRouter and TypeSafe, depending on configured model access. Card and ID photos are excluded from every model call; their report text can still be processed. Avoid putting identity numbers, bank details or other unnecessary personal information in text. Resend delivers sign-in and notification emails. Browser push providers deliver enabled alerts. The app is hosted on a Contabo server in Europe, and providers may process data outside Oman.
info.privacy.4.title: How long?
info.privacy.4.body: Open reports expire after 60 days without an update. Finished reports (returned, expired or closed), their photos and related chats are deleted after a further 182 days, about six months. Matching review logs are kept for up to 182 days. Accounts and active chats remain until deletion or applicable report cleanup. Daily cleanup means removal is not instantaneous. Nightly server backups are retained for 14 days.
info.privacy.5.title: Delete or correct your data
info.privacy.5.body: Edit reports and profile details in the app. Profile > Delete my account removes your account, reports, photos, push subscriptions and related chats from the live service. Matching logs may remain until their 182-day cleanup, and backup copies age out within 14 days. Contact us for access, correction, deletion or concerns about restored backup data.
info.privacy.6.title: Oman's PDPL
info.privacy.6.body: Oman's Personal Data Protection Law was issued by Royal Decree 6/2022 and has subsequent regulations and amendments. Before wider launch, the operator must review the pilot, overseas processing and these texts against the current requirements. The regulator's information is linked below.
info.help.0.title: Lost something?
info.help.0.body: Post a lost report from Home. Add the brand, colour, identifying marks and where and when you last had it. Zarqa looks for possible matches; check My reports and enable match alerts in Profile. Matching may be unavailable during the pilot.
info.help.1.title: Found something?
info.help.1.body: Post a found report and keep the item safe. When someone confirms a suggested match, a chat opens so you can check ownership and arrange a handover. Mark 'Got it back' only after the item has been returned.
info.help.2.title: Something feels off?
info.help.2.body: For a bug, mistaken claim, abusive message, privacy request or feedback, email hello@tryzarqa.com. Include a report reference if useful, but never send bank-card details, identity documents or sign-in codes. This inbox is not an emergency service.
info.tips.0.title: Meet where people are
info.tips.0.body: Choose a busy campus spot in daylight. Bring a friend if that feels better. Use chat to agree on a place and time, then confirm the handover.
info.tips.1.title: Check the little details
info.tips.1.body: Ask the claimant to describe a detail you have not shared, such as a sticker or what is inside a case. A match score is a clue, not proof of ownership.
info.tips.2.title: Keep private things private
info.tips.2.body: Do not share identity numbers, bank-card details, passwords or sign-in codes. For an ID or card, describe it without copying its numbers. Its uploaded photo stays private to the uploader.
info.tips.3.title: No pressure, no payments
info.tips.3.body: Do not pay a fee or follow an unfamiliar link to claim an item. If something feels wrong, stop the handover and contact us. Once the item is safely back, tap 'Got it back' so Zarqa can stop searching.
form.text.placeholder.lost: e.g. Black AirPods Pro case with a cat sticker on the back
form.text.placeholder.found: e.g. Black umbrella with a wooden handle
form.text.hint: Say what it is, plus colour, brand, stickers or marks. The more detail, the better I match.
form.cardNotice.body.lost: Only you can see these photos, even after a match, and they never go to AI. Describe the issuer and colour, plus your first name if it's printed on the card. Leave out ID and card numbers.
form.cardNotice.body.found: Your photo stays with you and never goes to AI. Add the first name on the card so I can find its owner, plus the issuer and colour. Skip the surname, ID and card numbers.
form.text.missing: Tell me what it is first.
form.photoError: I couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
form.limit.none: That's 10 posts today. Try again tomorrow.
